title: Kerma Museum
scope: Kerma Museum’s standing site-museum envelope, including the Nubian vaulted gallery ranges, its western visitor approach and daylight openings.
limitations: Unaltered mapped ground and the connected building outline are used. The number and distribution of vaults, exact glazing, dimensions above the footprint, colour, and west doorway detailing are modeled estimates.

Kerma’s 2008-built museum form is represented. The standing connected ranges follow the single mapped outline. Internal room attribution, exhibits, the Western Deffufa and other cultural precinct properties are outside the reconstruction.
